Adaptation: original 72px card / 50px bot / 58px masked conic orbit and its 2.2s rotation are retained. The current user-directed correction replaces the detailed colored head with one flat SVG logo mark: white rounded face, two near-black eyes without glints, a subtle single-arc smile and exactly six short mirrored leaf-shaped gills. The orbit uses semantic TweakCN primary/accent and the existing O2 Blue creative token. Theme surfaces/radius/font, scaled sizes, pause/reduced motion and accessible roles remain. The undefined standalone `.loader` element was omitted. No upstream code is fetched at runtime; no new dependency was added. The original reference files remain unchanged.

This 2D mark is a design draft. It does not replace or claim to be the approved V3 3D master image.
